notes:
High-level: POC with Redwood Private started Sept 2025 for internal support-bot + document search. Sponsor (Marta Reyes, Dir. of AI Products) led procurement but left in mid-Nov 2025. After her departure the product org went through a headcount freeze + platform reorg; no clear new owner. Security did an initial CISO review (good) but then flagged key management mismatch with their HSM provider — asked for KMS integration roadmap. We provided roadmap + pricing but platform team deprioritized LLM infra until FY26 budget confirmed. Competitive note: Final commercial terms accepted by competitor (Anthropic partner) for hosted+managed deployment — BlueHarbor told our AE they "needed faster time to market" and chose partner offering tighter marketplace integration.

CRM-style bullets / call notes:
- 2025-09-14: Intro demo w/ Marta + infra lead. POC scope agreed: 30d, 3 model variants, canary traffic to support agent.
- 2025-10-01: POC kick-off; SE assist (Andre K.), firewall/VPC checklist started.
- 2025-10-20: Security review call. CISO team requested HSM/KMS alignment. We shared KMS integration plan (drive link).
- 2025-11-12: Sponsor (Marta) informs AE she accepted new role outside company. "I can't carry this forward — you should work with Paige (Head of Platform)".
- 2025-12-03: Paige asks for updated SOW but then goes silent after org-wide hiring freeze announced.
- 2026-01-18: We received competitive win notification (partner-managed solution selected). AE attempted rescue call; no response.
- 2026-02-10: Final check-in email; bounced back as out-of-office for Platform exec. Marked as stalled/closed-lost in opportunity notes.

Quotes:
- "We like Redwood's latency profile but need on-prem parity with our HSM provider — that's non-negotiable." — Marta R. (Nov 2025)
- "Post-reorg priorities moved to observability and platform consolidation; LLM infra budgets deferred." — internal paraphrase from Paige (Dec 2025)

Sales takeaway / reason lost: Primary reason = sponsor departure + reorg => no internal champion. Secondary: budget freeze + competitor offered a packaged managed integration. Security KMS alignment created timing risk that the customer couldn't accept in current FY.
